asset.synopsis: Package asset is the catalogue and the image pipeline of gift: stable identities, metadata, the ordered collection a gallery is a view of, and the application wide service that turns a path or a URL into a decoded, oriented, cached thumbnail.

BackoffPolicy.synopsis: BackoffPolicy governs how a failing source is retried.

BudgetStats.synopsis: BudgetStats is one byte budget at one instant.

Collection.synopsis: Collection is an ordered catalogue of entries with stable IDs.

constructors.name: NewCollection
constructors.synopsis: NewCollection returns a collection over items.

methods.name: ApplyCorrections
methods.synopsis: ApplyCorrections folds a batch of late arriving facts into the catalogue and reports how many entries actually changed.

methods.name: At
methods.synopsis: At returns the metadata of entry i.

methods.name: DimensionsAt
methods.synopsis: DimensionsAt returns the oriented pixel size of entry i, or zeroes when it is not known yet.

methods.name: Find
methods.synopsis: Find returns the position of the entry with the given ID.

methods.name: ID
methods.synopsis: ID returns the stable identity of entry i, which is the cheap half of Collection.At and the one the frame path uses.

methods.name: Len
methods.synopsis: Len is the number of entries.

methods.name: MetadataVersion
methods.synopsis: MetadataVersion is the version of the *contents* of the entries: their dimensions and their revisions.

methods.name: Reorder
methods.synopsis: Reorder applies a new order given as positions into the current one: after the call, entry i is the entry that used to be at order[i].

methods.name: Reset
methods.synopsis: Reset replaces the whole catalogue and bumps both versions.

methods.name: Revision
methods.synopsis: Revision returns the content version of entry i; see Metadata.Revision.

methods.name: StructureVersion
methods.synopsis: StructureVersion is the version of the *shape* of the catalogue: which entries exist and in which order.

Correction.synopsis: Correction is a late arriving fact about one entry, addressed by its stable ID rather than by its position.

Decoder.synopsis: Decoder turns encoded bytes into an image.

DiskCacheConfig.synopsis: DiskCacheConfig configures the persistent thumbnail cache of the project plan, section 9, point 4.

DiskCacheStats.synopsis: DiskCacheStats are the persistent cache counters.
DiskCacheStats.decl:
type DiskCacheStats struct {
	Enabled                 bool
	Hits, Misses            uint64
	Writes, Evictions       uint64
	Corrupt                 uint64
	Errors                  uint64
	BytesRead, BytesWritten uint64
	SweptTemps              uint64
	Bytes                   int64
	Entries                 int
	Budget                  int64
}

FetchResult.synopsis: FetchResult is the answer to a conditional fetch.
FetchResult.decl:
type FetchResult struct {
	NotModified bool
	Revision    string
	Size        int64
	MIMEType    string
	Fresh       time.Duration
	Body        io.ReadCloser
}

Fetcher.synopsis: Fetcher is the optional extension for a source whose revision only becomes known by asking for the bytes, and which can be asked conditionally: HTTP.

FileSource.synopsis: FileSource is a picture in the local file system.

constructors.name: File
constructors.synopsis: File returns a source for the picture at path.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.synopsis: Metadata returns the identity and the guessed media type.

methods.name: Open
methods.synopsis: Open opens the file for reading.

methods.name: Path
methods.synopsis: Path is the cleaned absolute path.

methods.name: Probe
methods.synopsis: Probe stats the file.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String is the redacted description used in diagnostics.

HTTPSource.synopsis: HTTPSource is a picture behind an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

constructors.name: HTTP
constructors.synopsis: HTTP returns a source for the picture at rawURL.

methods.name: CacheNamespace
methods.synopsis: CacheNamespace is the credential fingerprint; see Namespacer.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.synopsis: Fetch performs a conditional GET; see Fetcher.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.synopsis: Metadata returns the redacted identity.

methods.name: Open
methods.synopsis: Open performs an unconditional GET.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String is the redacted URL.

methods.name: WithClient
methods.synopsis: WithClient sets the HTTP client.

methods.name: WithCredential
methods.synopsis: WithCredential adds an opaque credential fingerprint to the cache namespace without sending anything.

methods.name: WithHeader
methods.synopsis: WithHeader adds a request header.

methods.name: WithPublicQuery
methods.synopsis: WithPublicQuery names query parameters that are safe to keep legible in the identity, for example a width or a format.

methods.name: WithSecretQuery
methods.synopsis: WithSecretQuery declares query parameters as credentials.

ID.synopsis: ID is the stable identity of one catalogue entry.

Key.decl:
type Key struct {
	Namespace         string
	ID                ID
	Revision          string
	Size              int
	Orientation       Orientation
	ProcessingVersion uint32
}

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String is a stable, printable form of the key.

Metadata.synopsis: Metadata is what is known about one entry without opening it.

methods.name: HasDimensions
methods.synopsis: HasDimensions reports whether both dimensions are known.

Namespacer.synopsis: Namespacer is the optional extension for a source that must not share cache entries with other sources of the same URL.

Orientation.synopsis: Orientation is the EXIF orientation of a picture: how the stored pixel grid has to be transformed to be shown the right way up.

methods.name: Normalised
methods.synopsis: Normalised maps OrientationUnknown and any out of range value to OrientationTopLeft.

methods.name: Oriented
methods.synopsis: Oriented returns the presentation dimensions of a stored grid of w by h.

methods.name: SwapsAxes
methods.synopsis: SwapsAxes reports whether applying this orientation exchanges width and height.

Pipeline.synopsis: Pipeline is the application wide image service of the project plan, section 9.

constructors.name: NewPipeline
constructors.synopsis: NewPipeline starts a pipeline with cfg.

methods.name: Close
methods.synopsis: Close stops the workers and releases everything the pipeline holds.

methods.name: Forget
methods.synopsis: Forget clears the failure state of a source, so that the next request for it is attempted again.

methods.name: Invalidate
methods.synopsis: Invalidate drops every cached thumbnail of one picture from memory and forgets its revision hint, so the next request revalidates.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.synopsis: Lookup answers "do I already have this, right now" without scheduling anything.

methods.name: Request
methods.synopsis: Request schedules work and returns a ticket that can cancel it.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the counters.

Priority.synopsis: Priority is the two level scheduling class of the project plan, section 9: "Sichtbare Bilder haben Vorrang vor richtungsabhaengigem Prefetch."

ProbeResult.synopsis: ProbeResult is what a Prober learned about a source without transferring its bytes.

Prober.synopsis: Prober is the optional extension for a source whose revision is cheap to establish: a local file, where a probe is a stat.

Request.synopsis: Request is one demand for a thumbnail.
Request.decl:
type Request struct {
	Source     Source
	Size       int
	Priority   Priority
	Generation uint64
	OnResult   func(Result)
}

Result.synopsis: Result is the answer to one Request.
Result.decl:
type Result struct {
	ID                   ID
	Generation           uint64
	Size                 int
	Image                *Thumbnail
	Metadata             Metadata
	Orientation          Orientation
	Retry, Failure       error
	ImageWithheld        bool
	FromDisk, FromMemory bool
}

methods.name: Correction
methods.synopsis: Correction turns the metadata of a result into a catalogue correction, so that probed dimensions reach the gallery the way section 10 requires: by stable ID, in a batch.

methods.name: Err
methods.synopsis: Err returns whichever of Result.Failure and Result.Retry is set, or nil.

methods.name: OK
methods.synopsis: OK reports whether the request produced a picture.

ScaledDecoder.synopsis: ScaledDecoder is an optional extension of Decoder: a decoder that can produce a smaller picture than the stored one directly, for less work than decoding all of it.

Selection.synopsis: Selection is the durable selection and keyboard cursor of a catalogue.

constructors.name: NewSelection
constructors.synopsis: NewSelection returns an empty selection.

methods.name: Anchor
methods.synopsis: Anchor is the fixed end of a range extension; see Selection.SelectRange.

methods.name: Clear
methods.synopsis: Clear deselects everything, leaving the cursor where it is, and reports whether anything changed.

methods.name: Contains
methods.synopsis: Contains reports whether id is selected.

methods.name: Cursor
methods.synopsis: Cursor is the entry the keyboard focus of the gallery is on, or the empty ID when there is none.

methods.name: IDs
methods.synopsis: IDs appends every selected ID to dst and returns the extended slice.

methods.name: Len
methods.synopsis: Len is the number of selected entries.

methods.name: Only
methods.synopsis: Only makes id the entire selection and puts the cursor and the range anchor on it.

methods.name: Prune
methods.synopsis: Prune drops every selected ID and every cursor that c no longer contains, and reports whether anything was dropped.

methods.name: SelectRange
methods.synopsis: SelectRange replaces the selection with the entries from the anchor to id, inclusive, in the order c defines.

methods.name: Set
methods.synopsis: Set selects or deselects id and reports whether anything changed.

methods.name: SetCursor
methods.synopsis: SetCursor moves the cursor and, unless keepAnchor, the range anchor with it.

methods.name: Toggle
methods.synopsis: Toggle flips the state of id and reports the new state.

methods.name: Version
methods.synopsis: Version increases whenever the selection or the cursor changed.

Sniffer.synopsis: Sniffer is an optional extension of Decoder: a decoder that can recognise its own format from the first bytes.

Source.synopsis: Source is one addressable picture: what is known about it without opening it, and a way to open it.

Stats.synopsis: Stats is a snapshot of the pipeline's counters.
Stats.decl:
type Stats struct {
	Requests                                   uint64
	Deduplicated                               uint64
	Promotions                                 uint64
	Dropped, Cancelled                         uint64
	ReadyDropped                               uint64
	Completed, Failed                          uint64
	BackoffRefused, Quarantined                uint64

	QueuedVisible, QueuedPrefetch, InFlight    int
	Disk                                       DiskCacheStats
}

StatusError.synopsis: StatusError is a non-OK HTTP status.

methods.name: Temporary
methods.synopsis: Temporary reports whether retrying could plausibly help.

Thumbnail.synopsis: Thumbnail is one decoded, oriented, scaled picture in main memory.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds is the pixel rectangle, always anchored at the origin.

methods.name: Bytes
methods.synopsis: Bytes is the size of the pixel data, which is what the budget accounts.

methods.name: LadderSize
methods.synopsis: LadderSize is the rung of Config.Sizes this thumbnail was produced for.

methods.name: Orientation
methods.synopsis: Orientation is the EXIF orientation that was *applied*.

methods.name: Pix
methods.synopsis: Pix is the premultiplied RGBA pixel data, or nil after the last release.

methods.name: RGBA
methods.synopsis: RGBA returns an image.RGBA view of the same pixels, without copying.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release drops a reference and frees the pixels when it was the last one.

methods.name: Retain
methods.synopsis: Retain adds a reference.

methods.name: Revision
methods.synopsis: Revision is the content version these pixels were produced from, or empty for a source that has none.

methods.name: Stride
methods.synopsis: Stride is the distance between two rows in bytes.

methods.name: Width
methods.synopsis: Width and Height are the oriented pixel dimensions.

Ticket.synopsis: Ticket is a handle on an accepted request.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.synopsis: Cancel withdraws the request.

funcs.name: RegisterDecoder
funcs.synopsis: RegisterDecoder registers a decoder for a media type, replacing any earlier registration of the same type.

funcs.name: Retryable
funcs.synopsis: Retryable classifies a pipeline error for a consumer.

ebiten.synopsis: Package ebiten is gift's Ebitengine backend: the window, the frame loop and the GPU output.

AtlasStats.synopsis: AtlasStats are the glyph atlas counters.

	Rasterised                                                uint64
	Blanks                                                    uint64

Frame.synopsis: Frame is declared in both files so that the signatures above are legal without the tag.

GlassPolicy.synopsis: GlassPolicy chooses between render.Reduced and render.Full.

constructors.name: NewGlassPolicy
constructors.synopsis: NewGlassPolicy returns a policy at render.Full, unpinned.

methods.name: AddArea
methods.synopsis: AddArea accumulates the device pixel area of one material region of the frame in progress.

methods.name: BeginFrame
methods.synopsis: BeginFrame moves the policy on by one drawn frame and returns the level the frame is drawn at.

methods.name: IsPinned
methods.synopsis: IsPinned reports whether a level is pinned.

methods.name: Level
methods.synopsis: Level returns the effective quality level.

methods.name: Median
methods.synopsis: Median returns the median of the window, or zero while it is empty.

methods.name: Pin
methods.synopsis: Pin fixes the effective level.

methods.name: RecordInterval
methods.synopsis: RecordInterval adds one interval between drawn frames to the window.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the policy counters.

methods.name: TakeLevelChange
methods.synopsis: TakeLevelChange reports the level the policy last switched to and clears the flag, so that every change is reported exactly once and a run that did not change reports nothing.

methods.name: Unpin
methods.synopsis: Unpin returns control to the measurements.

GlassPolicyConfig.synopsis: GlassPolicyConfig configures the measurement based GlassPolicy.
GlassPolicyConfig.decl:
type GlassPolicyConfig struct {
	Window                   int
	DownInterval, UpInterval time.Duration
	MinDwellFrames           int
	MaxAreaFraction          float64
	UpAreaFraction           float64
	AreaWindow               int
}

GlassPolicyStats.synopsis: GlassPolicyStats are the counters of the policy.
GlassPolicyStats.decl:
type GlassPolicyStats struct {
	EffectiveLevel                                render.GlassQuality
	Pinned                                        bool
	Changes, Downgrades, AreaDowngrades, Upgrades uint64
	MedianInterval                                time.Duration
	AreaFraction                                  float64
	SubFrameIntervals                             uint64
}

GlyphAtlas.synopsis: GlyphAtlas packs rasterised glyph coverage into a bounded set of eb.Image pages.

constructors.name: NewGlyphAtlas
constructors.synopsis: NewGlyphAtlas returns an empty atlas.

methods.name: Entry
methods.synopsis: Entry returns the packed rectangle and bearing of an entry obtained from GlyphAtlas.Lookup.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.synopsis: Lookup returns the entry index for a glyph, rasterising and packing it if it is not cached yet, and reports whether the glyph could be resolved at all.

methods.name: Page
methods.synopsis: Page returns the image an entry lives on.

methods.name: Retry
methods.synopsis: Retry reports whether the frame last drawn turned glyphs away and GlyphAtlas.Tick has made room for them since, so that drawing again shows them.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the atlas counters.

methods.name: Tick
methods.synopsis: Tick advances the frame clock and evicts pages that have gone unread for longer than AtlasConfig.MaxAge.

LayerStats.synopsis: LayerStats are the counters of the layer cache.
LayerStats.decl:
type LayerStats struct {
	Composites             uint64
	Hits, Draws            uint64
	Reused                 uint64
	Through                uint64
	Allocations, Evictions uint64
	Resident               int
}

Material.synopsis: Material is what a batch is drawn with.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String makes a failing test readable.

Renderer.synopsis: Renderer is the render.Backend implementation on top of Ebitengine.

constructors.name: NewRenderer
constructors.synopsis: NewRenderer compiles the shape shader and returns a renderer.

methods.name: Atlas
methods.synopsis: Atlas returns the glyph atlas of this renderer, for GlyphAtlas.Stats and for a test that wants to configure the budget.

methods.name: BeginFrame
methods.synopsis: BeginFrame implements render.Backend.

methods.name: EndFrame
methods.synopsis: EndFrame implements render.Backend.

methods.name: GlassLevel
methods.synopsis: GlassLevel returns the policy's current effective level.

methods.name: GlassPolicy
methods.synopsis: GlassPolicy returns the adaptive quality policy.

methods.name: Images
methods.synopsis: Images returns the image resource service of this renderer.

methods.name: LayerStats
methods.synopsis: LayerStats returns the counters of the layer cache.

methods.name: NeedsFrame
methods.synopsis: NeedsFrame reports whether the frame last drawn left work that only another frame can finish: picture uploads the per frame budget deferred, or glyphs the atlas turned away and has made room for since; see GlyphAtlas.Tick.

methods.name: PinGlassQuality
methods.synopsis: PinGlassQuality fixes the effective glass level, or returns to the adaptive policy when given render.Adaptive.

methods.name: SetAtlas
methods.synopsis: SetAtlas replaces the glyph atlas.

methods.name: SetFinalTarget
methods.synopsis: SetFinalTarget draws the frame straight into Ebitengine's final screen instead of an offscreen; see Config.DirectToScreen.

methods.name: SetGlassPolicy
methods.synopsis: SetGlassPolicy replaces the policy.

methods.name: SetLayerCache
methods.synopsis: SetLayerCache turns the layer cache on, which is the default, or off.

methods.name: SetStaticBackdrops
methods.synopsis: SetStaticBackdrops turns static backdrops on, which is the default, or off.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.synopsis: SetTarget selects the image the next frame is drawn into.

methods.name: SetTargets
methods.synopsis: SetTargets replaces the target pool.

methods.name: SetTextures
methods.synopsis: SetTextures replaces the texture cache.

methods.name: SkipFrame
methods.synopsis: SkipFrame tells the renderer that a display refresh went by without a frame being drawn, because nothing had changed; see Config.DrawOnDemand.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns the renderer counters.

methods.name: Submit
methods.synopsis: Submit implements render.Backend.

methods.name: Targets
methods.synopsis: Targets returns the intermediate render target pool, for TargetStats and for a test that wants a small budget in order to observe reuse, rejection and release.

methods.name: Textures
methods.synopsis: Textures returns the texture cache, for TextureStats and for a test that wants a small budget in order to observe admission and eviction.

methods.name: Videos
methods.synopsis: Videos returns the video picture service, which Run installs into the app through gift.App.SetVideos.

methods.name: Accounted
methods.synopsis: Accounted is Ops + Skipped + UnknownKinds + Layers.Reused + Layers.Through.

methods.name: Skipped
methods.synopsis: Skipped is the total number of operations that produced no geometry.

TargetPool.synopsis: TargetPool owns the intermediate render targets of the glass material.

constructors.name: NewTargetPool
constructors.synopsis: NewTargetPool returns an empty pool.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.synopsis: Acquire leases a target at least w by h pixels, reusing a pooled one when the bucketed size matches.

methods.name: Close
methods.synopsis: Close deallocates every target the pool holds, leased or not.

methods.name: Leased
methods.synopsis: Leased reports how many targets are currently leased.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release returns a leased target to the pool.

methods.name: Stats
methods.synopsis: Stats returns a snapshot of the counters.

methods.name: Tick
methods.synopsis: Tick advances the frame clock and deallocates targets that have gone unused for longer than TargetConfig.MaxAge.

TextureCache.synopsis: TextureCache is the image resource service of this backend: residency, admission and eviction of decoded pictures on the GPU.

constructors.synopsis: NewTextureCache returns an empty cache.

methods.synopsis: Acquire implements render.Images.

methods.name: BeginFrame
methods.synopsis: BeginFrame resets the per drawn frame upload budget.

methods.name: Deallocate

methods.name: Deferred

methods.name: Resolve

methods.name: Stats

methods.name: Tick
methods.synopsis: Tick advances the frame clock and evicts textures that have gone undrawn for longer than TextureConfig.MaxAge.

VideoCache.synopsis: VideoCache is the render.Videos of this backend: one YUV texture per video, written once per new picture, and an RGB texture beside it for the frames that cannot convert in the pass that draws.

constructors.name: NewVideoCache
constructors.synopsis: NewVideoCache compiles the two conversion shaders.

methods.name: Present
methods.synopsis: Present implements render.Videos.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release implements render.Videos.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.synopsis: Resolve implements render.Videos.

funcs.name: GlassShaderSource

funcs.name: KawaseShaderSources
funcs.synopsis: KawaseShaderSources returns the downsample and upsample shaders of the dual-Kawase chain.

funcs.name: RoundImageShaderSource
funcs.synopsis: RoundImageShaderSource returns the Kage source of the rounded picture shader, under the same rule as ShapeShaderSource.

funcs.name: Run
funcs.synopsis: Run opens a window and drives app until it is closed.

funcs.name: ShapeShaderSource
funcs.synopsis: ShapeShaderSource returns the Kage source of the shared shape shader.

ffmpeg.synopsis: Package ffmpeg demultiplexes and decodes video and audio through the FFmpeg libraries of the system, loaded at run time with purego.

AudioDecoder.synopsis: AudioDecoder decodes the audio stream of a File to interleaved float32 stereo.

methods.name: Codec
methods.synopsis: Codec is the name of the codec.

methods.name: Flush
methods.synopsis: Flush drops everything buffered in the decoder and the resampler.

methods.name: Receive
methods.synopsis: Receive decodes the next frame, appends its samples to buf as interleaved stereo float32 at the output rate and returns the extended slice with the presentation time of the first appended sample.

methods.name: Send
methods.synopsis: Send is VideoDecoder.Send for audio.

methods.name: SetRate
methods.synopsis: SetRate changes the output sample rate from the next frame on.

AudioTrack.synopsis: AudioTrack describes one audio stream of a file.

	Codec      string
	Language   string
	Title      string
	Channels   int
	SampleRate int
	Default    bool
}

File.synopsis: File is an opened media file.

constructors.name: Open
constructors.synopsis: Open opens path, finds the best video and audio stream and opens a decoder for each.

methods.name: Audio
methods.synopsis: Audio is the decoder of the audio stream, or nil.

methods.name: AudioTrack
methods.synopsis: AudioTrack is the index into File.AudioTracks of the stream that plays, or -1 for a file without sound.

methods.name: AudioTracks
methods.synopsis: AudioTracks lists the audio streams of the file.

methods.name: Close
methods.synopsis: Close releases the decoders and the file.

methods.name: Info
methods.synopsis: Info describes the file.

methods.name: ReadPacket
methods.synopsis: ReadPacket reads the next packet of the video or the audio stream; packets of other streams are skipped.

methods.name: Seek
methods.synopsis: Seek moves the read position to the last key frame at or before t.

methods.name: SetAudioRate
methods.synopsis: SetAudioRate changes the output rate of every audio decoder of the file, taking effect with the next decoded frame.

methods.name: SetAudioTrack
methods.synopsis: SetAudioTrack makes track i of File.AudioTracks the one File.ReadPacket reads and File.Audio decodes.

methods.name: Video
methods.synopsis: Video is the decoder of the video stream, or nil.

methods.synopsis: IsPointer reports whether e is a pointer event, that is one with a meaningful Pos.

EventContext.synopsis: EventContext is the interface of an Interactor to the runtime.

methods.name: After
methods.synopsis: After asks for one EventTimer to be delivered to the receiving node d from now, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: Animate
methods.synopsis: Animate keeps the receiving node marked for repaint for the next d, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds returns the absolute rectangle of the receiving node, as computed by the last layout pass.

methods.name: Capture
methods.synopsis: Capture is EventContext.StealPointer for the pointer id rather than the one whose event is being dispatched: for a recogniser that decides on a timer, when no pointer event is on its way — a long press that turns into a context menu takes the finger from the tile it rests on, so that the tile does not treat the release as a tap.

methods.name: ClearFocus
methods.synopsis: ClearFocus removes the keyboard focus from whatever holds it.

methods.name: ControlState
methods.synopsis: ControlState returns the control state of the node receiving the event.

methods.name: DeviceBounds
methods.synopsis: DeviceBounds returns the rectangle of the receiving node mapped through the transforms of its ancestors, which is the space Event.Pos lives in.

methods.name: DismissSoftKeyboard
methods.synopsis: DismissSoftKeyboard puts the on-screen keyboard away from inside an event handler, by blurring whatever asked for it, and reports whether there was one up.

methods.name: Interaction
methods.synopsis: Interaction returns the hover, press, focus and disabled state gift maintains for the receiving node.

methods.name: KeyDown
methods.synopsis: KeyDown injects a key press, as App.KeyDown does for the backend.

methods.name: KeyUp
methods.synopsis: KeyUp injects a key release; see EventContext.KeyDown.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the timestamp of the event being dispatched, on the clock App.BeginInput is given: the clock a control's animation is started on.

methods.name: PointerIsDown
methods.synopsis: PointerIsDown reports whether the pointer id is currently pressed: the mouse with its primary button held, or a finger on the glass.

methods.name: Presenter
methods.synopsis: Presenter is LayoutContext.Presenter for the node receiving the event.

methods.name: Repaint
methods.synopsis: Repaint marks the receiving node as needing to be drawn again, without rebuilding or re measuring anything.

methods.name: RequestFocus
methods.synopsis: RequestFocus moves the keyboard focus to the receiving node, if it declared itself focusable.

methods.name: RequestLayout
methods.synopsis: RequestLayout marks the receiving node as needing another layout pass in the next update, without rebuilding anything.

methods.name: RequestSoftKeyboard
methods.synopsis: RequestSoftKeyboard declares whether the receiving node wants an on-screen keyboard, and asks for a rebuild when the answer changed.

methods.name: Retained
methods.synopsis: Retained returns the value of type T the receiving node keeps across builds, creating a zero T on first use.

methods.name: ScrollBy
methods.synopsis: ScrollBy moves the scroll container receiving the event by d document units and reports whether the offset changed; see EventContext.ScrollTo.

methods.name: ScrollIndicator
methods.synopsis: ScrollIndicator returns the indicator state of the scroll container receiving the event, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: ScrollInfo
methods.synopsis: ScrollInfo returns the state of the scroll container receiving the event, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.synopsis: ScrollIntoView adjusts every scroll container above the receiving node so that the node is visible, and reports whether anything moved.

methods.name: ScrollTo
methods.synopsis: ScrollTo moves the scroll container receiving the event to the document offset off, clamped, and reports whether the offset changed.

methods.name: SetControlState
methods.synopsis: SetControlState writes the control state of the node receiving the event and marks it for repaint when it changed.

methods.name: SetScrollIndicator
methods.synopsis: SetScrollIndicator writes the indicator state of the scroll container receiving the event and reports whether it changed.

methods.name: StealPointer
methods.synopsis: StealPointer moves the capture of the pointer whose event is being dispatched to the receiving node, and reports whether the node holds it afterwards.

methods.name: TypeRune
methods.synopsis: TypeRune injects one character as though the platform's keyboard had produced it.

Interaction.synopsis: Interaction is the presentation state gift maintains for an interactive node.
Interaction.decl:
type Interaction struct {
	Hover        bool
	Pressed      bool
	Focused      bool
	FocusVisible bool
	Disabled     bool
}

Interactor.synopsis: Interactor is the retained half of a view that wants input.

constructors.name: ScrollInteractor
constructors.synopsis: ScrollInteractor returns the Interactor gift installs on a scroll container that brought none of its own: wheel, drag past DragSlop and the kinetic fling, with the overscroll chaining rule described on it.

Key.synopsis: Key is a physical key, in the small set gift's own navigation, activation and text editing need.

LayoutContext.synopsis: LayoutContext gives a Layouter access to its children.

methods.name: After
methods.synopsis: After is EventContext.After for the node being laid out.

methods.name: AnchorScroll
methods.synopsis: AnchorScroll pins this scroll container's viewport to the document coordinate off, clamped to the content reported so far, and reports whether the offset changed.

methods.name: Animate
methods.synopsis: Animate keeps the node being laid out marked for repaint for the next d, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: ChildBaseline
methods.synopsis: ChildBaseline returns the baseline the given child reported during this layout pass, and whether it reported one at all.

methods.name: ChildCount
methods.synopsis: ChildCount returns the number of children of the node being laid out.

methods.name: ChildFlex
methods.synopsis: ChildFlex returns Element.Flex of the given child, zero for an inflexible one.

methods.name: ChildSize
methods.synopsis: ChildSize returns the size a child chose in a preceding LayoutContext.Measure.

methods.name: ControlState
methods.synopsis: ControlState returns the control state of the node being laid out.

methods.name: Density
methods.synopsis: Density returns the device density, that is how many physical pixels one logical pixel covers.

methods.name: Invalidator
methods.synopsis: Invalidator returns a function that marks this node for layout from outside the frame, and nil for a node that is no longer part of the tree.

methods.name: Measure
methods.synopsis: Measure lays out the given child with the constraints c and returns the size the child chose.

methods.name: Node
methods.synopsis: Node returns a reference to the node being laid out.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the timestamp of the input phase this layout pass belongs to, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: OffScreen
methods.synopsis: OffScreen reports whether the node being laid out is inside a subtree that declared Element.Hidden.

methods.name: Pass
methods.synopsis: Pass returns the ordinal of the layout pass this call belongs to.

methods.name: Place
methods.synopsis: Place positions the given child at the offset at, relative to the origin of the node being laid out.

methods.name: Presenter
methods.synopsis: Presenter returns the rectangle, in device space, of the node that presents the overlay the node being laid out is in, and whether it is in one; see Element.Overlay.

methods.name: ReportBaseline
methods.synopsis: ReportBaseline records the distance from the top of this node to the baseline its content sits on, in logical pixels.

methods.name: ReportOverflow
methods.synopsis: ReportOverflow records that this node's content did not fit into the size it reported, by over logical pixels per axis.

methods.name: ReportScrollContent
methods.synopsis: ReportScrollContent tells gift how far the content of this scroll container reaches and where local coordinate zero sits in the document.

methods.name: RequestBuild
methods.synopsis: RequestBuild asks gift to rebuild the component instance that produced this node, in the next update.

methods.name: RequestLayout
methods.synopsis: RequestLayout asks for another layout pass over this node in the next update, without rebuilding anything.

methods.name: Retained
methods.synopsis: Retained is EventContext.Retained for the node being laid out.

methods.name: ScrollOffset
methods.synopsis: ScrollOffset returns the current offset of this scroll container, for a layouter that virtualises its content and therefore has to know which part of the document it is being asked to produce.

methods.name: SetChildLabel
methods.synopsis: SetChildLabel replaces Element.Label of the given child until that child is built again.

methods.name: SetControlState
methods.synopsis: SetControlState writes the control state of the node being laid out.

Layouter.synopsis: Layouter measures a node and places its children.

Mods.synopsis: Mods is the set of modifier keys held while an event happened.

methods.name: Has
methods.synopsis: Has reports whether every modifier in m is set in s.

NodeRef.synopsis: NodeRef refers to one node of the retained tree.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether r refers to no node.

PaintContext.synopsis: PaintContext is the interface of a Painter to the display list.

methods.name: Add
methods.synopsis: Add appends op to the display list.

methods.name: AddMaterial
methods.synopsis: AddMaterial appends a material to the side table of the display list and returns its index, for render.Op.Material.

methods.name: Animate
methods.synopsis: Animate keeps the node being painted marked for repaint for the next d.

methods.name: AppendGlyph
methods.synopsis: AppendGlyph appends one positioned glyph to the display list.

methods.name: Audio
methods.synopsis: Audio returns the backend's sound device, or nil when there is none.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds returns the absolute rectangle of the node being painted, as computed by the last layout pass.

methods.name: ChildCount
methods.synopsis: ChildCount returns the number of children of the node being painted.

methods.name: ControlState
methods.synopsis: ControlState returns the control state of the node being painted.

methods.name: DeviceBounds
methods.synopsis: DeviceBounds returns the rectangle of the node being painted mapped through the transform that is active for it, which is the space clips live in.

methods.name: GlyphsLen
methods.synopsis: GlyphsLen returns the current length of the glyph side table of the display list, which is the index the next PaintContext.AppendGlyph writes to.

methods.name: Images
methods.synopsis: Images returns the backend's image resource service, or nil when there is none.

methods.name: Interaction
methods.synopsis: Interaction returns the hover, press, focus and disabled state gift maintains for the node being painted.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the timestamp of the input phase this frame was drawn after, on the clock App.BeginInput is given.

methods.name: OverlayLeaving
methods.synopsis: OverlayLeaving reports how far the overlay the node being painted is in has gone on its way out, from zero to one, and whether it is leaving at all: a withdrawn overlay stays on the screen for Element.OverlayExit so that it can animate away, and takes no input meanwhile.

methods.name: PaintChild
methods.synopsis: PaintChild paints the child with the given index.

methods.name: PaintChildren
methods.synopsis: PaintChildren paints all children of the current node, in order.

methods.name: PopClip
methods.synopsis: PopClip removes the innermost clip pushed by this painter.

methods.name: PopTransform
methods.synopsis: PopTransform ends the innermost PaintContext.PushTransform of this painter.

methods.name: Presenter
methods.synopsis: Presenter is LayoutContext.Presenter for the node being painted.

methods.name: PushClip
methods.synopsis: PushClip intersects r, which is in device space, with the active clip and makes the result active for all following operations until the matching PaintContext.PopClip.

methods.name: PushTransform
methods.synopsis: PushTransform applies m to everything this painter adds from now on and to the children it paints, until the matching PaintContext.PopTransform.

methods.name: Retained
methods.synopsis: Retained is EventContext.Retained for the node being painted.

methods.name: ScrollIndicator
methods.synopsis: ScrollIndicator returns the indicator state of the scroll container being painted, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: ScrollInfo
methods.synopsis: ScrollInfo returns the state of the scroll container being painted, and false when this node is not one.

methods.name: TransitionPhase
methods.synopsis: TransitionPhase returns how far the subtree being painted is through a transition: 0 at rest, 1 fully parked.

methods.name: Videos
methods.synopsis: Videos returns the backend's video picture service, or nil when there is none.

Painter.synopsis: Painter emits the drawing operations of one node.

PointerKind.synopsis: PointerKind tells a mouse from a finger.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String returns "mouse" or "touch".

ScrollAxis.synopsis: ScrollAxis is the single axis a scroll container moves along.

methods.name: String
methods.synopsis: String returns "none", "vertical" or "horizontal".

ScrollConfig.synopsis: ScrollConfig tunes the gesture behaviour of one scroll container.
ScrollConfig.decl:
type ScrollConfig struct {
	Friction                    float32
	FlingVelocity               float32
	StopVelocity                float32
	MaxVelocity                 float32
	WheelStep, PreciseWheelStep float32
	HardStop                    bool
}

ScrollIndicatorState.synopsis: ScrollIndicatorState is the presentation state of the decoration that draws a scroll container's position — the grab of its thumb and the hover of its track.

methods.name: Active
methods.synopsis: Active reports whether the indicator is engaged by the pointer in either sense.

ScrollInfo.synopsis: ScrollInfo is a snapshot of the state of one scroll container.
ScrollInfo.decl:
type ScrollInfo struct {
	Axis           ScrollAxis
	Offset         float64
	MaxOffset      float64
	ContentExtent  float64
	ContentOrigin  float64
	ViewportExtent float32
	Velocity       float32
	Flinging       bool
	Dragging       bool
	Virtual        bool
	Overscroll     float32
	IdleFor        time.Duration
}

ScrollSpec.synopsis: ScrollSpec declares a node to be a scroll viewport.

State.synopsis: State is a typed, observable value owned by one component instance.

methods.name: Binding
methods.synopsis: Binding returns a read/write handle to this state.

methods.name: Get
methods.synopsis: Get returns the current value without registering a dependency.

methods.name: Set
methods.synopsis: Set stores v and invalidates every scope that read this state in its last build.

Token.synopsis: Token identifies one asynchronous request of one component instance.

methods.name: Post
methods.synopsis: Post hands fn to the UI executor, like App.Post, and runs it there only if the token is still Token.Valid by then: the result of a request that was replaced, or whose component was unmounted, is dropped.

methods.name: Valid
methods.synopsis: Valid reports whether the result of this request may still be applied: the component instance is still mounted and no newer request has been started on it.

TransitionSpec.synopsis: TransitionSpec declares where a node sits while it is hidden, so that Element.Hidden becomes a movement instead of a cut.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether the spec asks for no movement at all.

TypeID.synopsis: TypeID is a process wide stable identifier of a concrete view type.

constructors.name: RegisterType
constructors.synopsis: RegisterType registers a view type under the given name and returns its TypeID.

ValueReporter.synopsis: ValueReporter is implemented by an Interactor whose node edits a value, so that a tool outside the frame path can read what the control holds.
ValueReporter.decl: type ValueReporter interface{ AccessibleValue(st ControlState) string }

View.synopsis: View is a short lived description of a piece of user interface.

constructors.name: Component
constructors.signature: Component(key string, fn func(*Context) View) View
constructors.synopsis: Component mounts fn as a stateful component instance with a state scope of its own.

constructors.name: Memo
constructors.signature: Memo[P comparable](key string, props P, fn func(*Context, P) View) View
constructors.synopsis: Memo mounts a stateful component that is only rebuilt when props changes or when one of its own state dependencies fires.

funcs.name: RegisteredTypeNames
funcs.synopsis: RegisteredTypeNames appends the names of every registered view type to dst and returns the extended slice.

funcs.name: RoundDensity
funcs.synopsis: RoundDensity turns a raw device scale factor into the integer density gift works in.

funcs.name: TypeName
funcs.synopsis: TypeName returns the name a type was registered under, or a placeholder for an unknown ID.

gifttest.synopsis: Package gifttest drives a gift application from a Go test.

Harness.synopsis: Harness is one application under test: the gift.App, the injected clock and the viewport.

constructors.name: New
constructors.synopsis: New mounts the view and brings it to a settled, painted steady state.

methods.name: Advance
methods.synopsis: Advance moves the injected clock forward by d and settles.

methods.name: AdvanceTicks
methods.synopsis: AdvanceTicks moves the injected clock forward n times by step, opening an input phase and settling at each stop.

methods.name: App
methods.synopsis: App returns the application under test, for the cases this package has no verb for.

methods.name: AssertCount
methods.synopsis: AssertCount fails unless exactly want nodes match s, listing the ones that did.

methods.name: AssertExists
methods.synopsis: AssertExists fails when nothing matches s.

methods.name: AssertFocus
methods.synopsis: AssertFocus fails unless the focused node matches s.

methods.name: AssertGolden
methods.synopsis: AssertGolden compares the rendered frame against the PNG in testdata.

methods.name: AssertNoFocus
methods.synopsis: AssertNoFocus fails when anything holds the keyboard focus.

methods.name: AssertNoOverflow
methods.synopsis: AssertNoOverflow fails when any node's content does not fit the size it reported.

methods.name: AssertNone
methods.synopsis: AssertNone fails when anything matches s, naming what did.

methods.name: AssertOpaque
methods.synopsis: AssertOpaque fails unless every pixel of the framebuffer is fully opaque.

methods.name: AssertOps
methods.signature: AssertOps(desc string, want int, pred func(render.Op) bool)
methods.synopsis: AssertOps fails unless exactly want operations of the most recent frame satisfy pred.

methods.name: AssertPixel
methods.synopsis: AssertPixel fails unless the pixel at p is want, within GoldenTolerance.

methods.name: At
methods.synopsis: At returns the topmost interactive node at the device space point p.

methods.name: CancelPointer
methods.synopsis: CancelPointer ends the current mouse press without a release, as the window manager does when the window loses focus.

methods.name: CancelTouch
methods.synopsis: CancelTouch ends the current touch without a release.

methods.name: ClickAt
methods.synopsis: ClickAt clicks at a device space point.

methods.name: Density
methods.synopsis: Density returns the device density in force, after the rounding of gift.RoundDensity.

methods.name: Diagnostics
methods.synopsis: Diagnostics returns the counter snapshot of the application, for the tests whose subject is the frame path itself — "this hover rebuilt nothing" is an assertion about gift.Diagnostics.Builds.

methods.name: Dump
methods.synopsis: Dump returns the retained tree as indented text: type, key, label, bounds and the input flags of every node.

methods.name: Exists
methods.synopsis: Exists reports whether at least one node matches s, without failing.

methods.name: Find
methods.synopsis: Find returns the single node matching s and fails the test when there is not exactly one.

methods.name: FindAll
methods.synopsis: FindAll returns every node matching s, in document order.

methods.name: FingerDown
methods.synopsis: FingerDown puts the finger with the given identifier down at the device space point p and leaves it there.

methods.name: FingerMove
methods.synopsis: FingerMove moves the finger id to p without advancing the clock.

methods.name: FingerUp
methods.synopsis: FingerUp lifts the finger id at p.

methods.name: First
methods.synopsis: First returns the first node matching s in document order and fails when there is none.

methods.name: Fling
methods.synopsis: Fling is a finger that goes down at from, travels to to in d at an even speed with one move per FrameInterval, and lifts there.

methods.name: Focused
methods.synopsis: Focused returns the node that currently holds the keyboard focus, and whether anything does.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame advances exactly one frame: input phase, update, paint.

methods.name: Image
methods.synopsis: Image renders the current frame and returns it.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key presses and releases one key, with the given modifiers held.

methods.name: KeyDown
methods.synopsis: KeyDown presses a key and leaves it down.

methods.name: KeyUp
methods.synopsis: KeyUp releases a key.

methods.name: List
methods.synopsis: List returns the borrowed display list of the most recent frame, for the assertions that need the clip and transform side tables — render.List.Clip and render.List.Glyphs are only meaningful against the list they came from.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.synopsis: MoveTo moves the mouse to the device space point p.

methods.name: Now
methods.synopsis: Now returns the value of the injected clock, as a duration since an arbitrary origin.

methods.name: Ops
methods.synopsis: Ops returns a copy of the display list of the most recent frame.

methods.name: Pinch
methods.signature: Pinch(centre geom.Point, fromSpread, toSpread float32, d time.Duration)
methods.synopsis: Pinch puts two fingers down on a horizontal line through centre, spread fromSpread apart, moves them to toSpread apart in d with one move per FrameInterval, and lifts them.

methods.name: PressAt
methods.synopsis: PressAt presses the mouse at p.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release releases the mouse wherever it currently is.

methods.name: ReleaseAt
methods.synopsis: ReleaseAt releases the mouse at p.

methods.name: Resize
methods.synopsis: Resize changes the viewport and settles.

methods.name: SetModifiers
methods.synopsis: SetModifiers records which modifier keys are held from now on.

methods.name: Settle
methods.synopsis: Settle pumps frames until the application stops changing, and fails if it never does.

methods.name: ShiftTab
methods.synopsis: ShiftTab moves the keyboard focus to the previous focusable node.

methods.name: Size
methods.synopsis: Size returns the current viewport.

methods.name: Tab
methods.synopsis: Tab moves the keyboard focus to the next focusable node, by actually pressing tab.

methods.name: TapAt
methods.synopsis: TapAt is a touch at a device space point: a finger goes down there and comes straight up again.

methods.name: TouchDownAt
methods.synopsis: TouchDownAt puts a finger down at the device space point p and leaves it there.

methods.name: TouchMoveTo
methods.synopsis: TouchMoveTo moves the finger that is down to p.

methods.name: TouchUpAt
methods.synopsis: TouchUpAt lifts the finger at p.

methods.name: TypeRune
methods.synopsis: TypeRune types a single character.

methods.name: TypeText
methods.synopsis: TypeText types the string, one character at a time, as a keyboard with the user's layout would deliver it.

methods.name: Warm
methods.synopsis: Warm is a no-op in a build without a graphics context.

methods.name: Wheel
methods.synopsis: Wheel scrolls at the device space point p by d.

Node.synopsis: Node is one node of the retained tree, as a test refers to it.

methods.name: AssertAtScrollEnd
methods.synopsis: AssertAtScrollEnd fails unless the container is at its maximum offset.

methods.name: AssertAtScrollStart
methods.synopsis: AssertAtScrollStart fails unless the container is at offset zero.

methods.name: AssertBackground
methods.synopsis: AssertBackground fails unless the node fills its shape with want.

methods.name: AssertBounds
methods.synopsis: AssertBounds fails unless the node's rectangle equals want within [boundsTolerance], reporting the difference per edge.

methods.name: AssertDisabled
methods.synopsis: AssertDisabled fails when the node is not disabled.

methods.name: AssertDrawsGlyphs
methods.synopsis: AssertDrawsGlyphs fails when the node's bounds contain no glyph in the most recent frame.

methods.name: AssertDrawsImage
methods.synopsis: AssertDrawsImage fails when the node draws no picture in the most recent frame.

methods.name: AssertEnabled
methods.synopsis: AssertEnabled fails when the node is disabled.

methods.name: AssertFocused
methods.synopsis: AssertFocused fails when the node does not hold the keyboard focus.

methods.name: AssertGlassQuality
methods.synopsis: AssertGlassQuality fails unless the node's glass material requested want.

methods.name: AssertHovered
methods.synopsis: AssertHovered fails when no mouse is over the node.

methods.name: AssertKey
methods.synopsis: AssertKey fails unless the node's reconciliation key is want.

methods.name: AssertMaterial
methods.synopsis: AssertMaterial fails unless the node paints a material of kind want.

methods.name: AssertNotFocused
methods.synopsis: AssertNotFocused fails when the node holds the keyboard focus.

methods.name: AssertNotHovered
methods.synopsis: AssertNotHovered fails when the node is hovered.

methods.name: AssertNotPressed
methods.synopsis: AssertNotPressed fails when the node is pressed.

methods.name: AssertNotVisible
methods.synopsis: AssertNotVisible fails when any part of the node survives the clips above it.

methods.name: AssertPaints
methods.synopsis: AssertPaints fails unless at least one operation of the most recent frame is of kind k, covers the node and is drawn in colour c.

methods.name: AssertPressed
methods.synopsis: AssertPressed fails when the node is not pressed.

methods.name: AssertScrollOffset
methods.synopsis: AssertScrollOffset fails unless the nearest scroll container at or above the node sits at the document offset want, within [boundsTolerance].

methods.name: AssertSize
methods.synopsis: AssertSize fails unless the node's size equals want within [boundsTolerance].

methods.name: AssertText
methods.synopsis: AssertText fails unless the node's label is exactly want.

methods.name: AssertType
methods.synopsis: AssertType fails unless the node was built from the view type registered under want, such as "ui.Button".

methods.name: AssertValue
methods.synopsis: AssertValue fails unless the value the node's control reports is exactly want; see Node.Value.

methods.name: AssertVisible
methods.synopsis: AssertVisible fails when the node is entirely clipped away by an ancestor, naming the clip that removed it.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background returns the colour the node fills its shape with in the most recent frame, and whether it fills one at all.

methods.name: Bounds
methods.synopsis: Bounds returns the rectangle of the node in device space: where it actually is on screen, after the scroll offsets and transforms above it.

methods.name: Center
methods.synopsis: Center returns the point the pointer actions aim at: the middle of the *visible* part of the node.

methods.name: Children
methods.synopsis: Children returns the children of the node, in order.

methods.name: Click
methods.synopsis: Click moves the mouse onto the node, presses and releases it.

methods.name: Describe
methods.synopsis: Describe returns the one line form of the node used in failure messages: type, key, label and device bounds.

methods.name: Drag
methods.synopsis: Drag presses the mouse on this node, moves it to the centre of dst in several steps and releases it there.

methods.name: DragTo
methods.synopsis: DragTo presses the mouse on this node, moves it to the device space point p in several steps and releases it there.

methods.name: Find
methods.synopsis: Find returns the single node in this node's subtree, including itself, that matches s, and fails when there is not exactly one.

methods.name: Fling
methods.synopsis: Fling is a touch drag along d that takes over milliseconds of the injected clock, so that gift can measure a release velocity and start a kinetic scroll.

methods.name: Focus
methods.synopsis: Focus moves the keyboard focus to this node and fails when it cannot take it, which is the honest answer for a disabled or non focusable node.

methods.name: Glass
methods.synopsis: Glass returns the glass parameters of the node's material and fails when it has none.

methods.name: Glyphs
methods.synopsis: Glyphs returns the glyphs of the most recent frame that lie inside the node's bounds, which is how a headless test says "something was actually drawn here" for text.

methods.name: Hover
methods.synopsis: Hover moves the mouse onto the node without pressing.

methods.name: Interaction
methods.synopsis: Interaction returns the hover, press, focus and disabled state gift keeps for the node.

methods.name: IsVisible
methods.synopsis: IsVisible reports whether any part of the node survives the clips above it.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether n refers to no node at all.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key returns the reconciliation key of the node, or "".

methods.name: LayoutBounds
methods.synopsis: LayoutBounds returns the rectangle the layout gave the node, without the transforms of its ancestors.

methods.name: LongPress
methods.synopsis: LongPress puts a finger on the node, holds it past gift.LongPressDelay and lifts it.

methods.name: Material
methods.synopsis: Material returns the backdrop dependent background of the node in the most recent frame, and whether it has one.

methods.name: Parent
methods.synopsis: Parent returns the parent node.

methods.name: Press
methods.synopsis: Press moves the mouse onto the node and presses the button, leaving it down.

methods.name: PressKey
methods.synopsis: PressKey focuses the node and sends one key press and release to it.

methods.name: Ref
methods.synopsis: Ref returns the underlying gift.NodeRef, for the escape hatch through Harness.App.

methods.name: Release
methods.synopsis: Release releases the mouse button over this node.

methods.name: ScrollBy
methods.synopsis: ScrollBy moves the nearest scroll container at or above this node by d document units.

methods.name: ScrollInfo
methods.synopsis: ScrollInfo returns the full state of the nearest scroll container at or above this node.

methods.name: ScrollIntoView
methods.synopsis: ScrollIntoView scrolls every container above this node until it is visible.

methods.name: ScrollOffset
methods.synopsis: ScrollOffset returns the document offset of the nearest scroll container at or above this node.

methods.name: ScrollTo
methods.synopsis: ScrollTo moves the nearest scroll container at or above this node to the document offset off, clamped to its bounds.

methods.name: Scroller
methods.synopsis: Scroller returns the nearest scroll container at or above this node, and fails when there is none.

Selector.synopsis: Selector is a predicate over the nodes of the retained tree.

constructors.name: Any
constructors.synopsis: Any matches every node in the tree.

constructors.name: ByKey

constructors.name: ByText
constructors.synopsis: ByText matches a node whose label is exactly s.

constructors.name: ByTextContains

constructors.name: ByType
constructors.synopsis: ByType matches a node built from the view type registered under name, such as "ui.Button" or "ui.Text".

constructors.name: Enabled

constructors.name: Focusable

constructors.name: Interactive

constructors.name: Not

constructors.name: Under

constructors.name: Visible

constructors.name: Where

methods.name: And

methods.name: Or

methods.name: String

imageviewer.synopsis: Package imageviewer shows pictures as large and as interactive as the screen allows: a picture that zooms and pans in place, and a full screen viewer that pages through a catalogue, in the manner of iOS's Photos.

FullscreenView.synopsis: FullscreenView is the view of a Viewer; see Fullscreen.

constructors.name: Fullscreen
constructors.synopsis: Fullscreen returns the full screen view of v.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background sets the colour behind the pictures.

methods.name: Card
methods.synopsis: Card sets the content of the card a swipe up reveals below the picture: details, metadata, actions.

methods.name: Closable
methods.synopsis: Closable sets whether the user can close the viewer with a gesture or a key; Viewer.Close works either way.

methods.name: DoubleTapZoom
methods.synopsis: DoubleTapZoom sets the zoom of a double tap; see ZoomableView.DoubleTapZoom.

methods.name: Key

methods.name: MaxZoom
methods.synopsis: MaxZoom sets the largest zoom; see ZoomableView.MaxZoom.

methods.name: ShowsControls
methods.synopsis: ShowsControls sets whether the close button and the arrows are drawn.

methods.name: Spacing
methods.synopsis: Spacing sets the gap between two pages.

methods.name: Wheel
methods.synopsis: Wheel sets what the wheel does.

Origin.synopsis: Origin is where the pictures of a viewer are shown small: a gallery, a row of thumbnails, a filmstrip.

Viewer.synopsis: Viewer is the retained model of a full screen picture viewer: the catalogue it pages through, the picture it shows, and everything the gestures leave behind between two frames — the zoom, the position of the pages, a picture half dragged away.

constructors.name: New
constructors.synopsis: New returns a closed viewer over the catalogue c, whose entries sources resolves to something the image pipeline can open — the same resolver a ui.Gallery is given.

methods.name: Close
methods.synopsis: Close shrinks the picture back into its thumbnail and closes the viewer.

methods.name: Collection
methods.synopsis: Collection returns the catalogue the viewer pages through.

methods.name: Current
methods.synopsis: Current returns the entry the viewer shows, and whether it is open.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.synopsis: IsOpen reports whether the viewer is on the screen, opening or closing included.

methods.name: Next
methods.synopsis: Next turns to the next picture, as the right arrow key does, and reports whether there is one.

methods.name: OnChange
methods.synopsis: OnChange sets the function called when the viewer shows a different picture, after a page was turned, and when it opens.

methods.name: OnClose
methods.synopsis: OnClose sets the function called when the viewer has closed, after the transition back.

methods.name: Open
methods.synopsis: Open shows the entry id, growing it out of its thumbnail in the origin.

methods.name: Previous
methods.synopsis: Previous turns to the previous picture.

methods.name: SetOrigin
methods.synopsis: SetOrigin sets where the viewer opens from and closes into.

WheelMode.synopsis: WheelMode says what the wheel does over a zoomable picture.

ZoomableView.synopsis: ZoomableView is a picture that can be zoomed and panned in place: pinched, double tapped, wheeled and moved with the keys.

constructors.name: Zoomable
constructors.synopsis: Zoomable returns a zoomable view of src.

methods.name: Background

methods.name: DoubleTapZoom
methods.synopsis: DoubleTapZoom sets the zoom a double tap goes to.

methods.name: Flex

methods.name: MaxZoom

methods.name: Wheel
methods.synopsis: Wheel sets what the wheel does; see WheelMode.

motion.synopsis: Package motion is the arithmetic of things that move under a finger and after it: the rubber band past an edge, the deceleration of a fling, and the spring that brings something home.

Decay.synopsis: Decay is the free deceleration of a fling: a velocity that is multiplied by Rate every millisecond.

methods.name: At
methods.signature: At(t time.Duration, x0, v0 float64) (x, v float64)
methods.synopsis: At returns the position and velocity t after a release at x0 with velocity v0, in units and units per second.

methods.name: Duration
methods.synopsis: Duration is how long a release with velocity v0 takes until its speed falls below minSpeed units per second.

methods.name: Rest
methods.synopsis: Rest is where a release at x0 with velocity v0 comes to rest.

Glide.synopsis: Glide is the motion of content let go between two edges: it decelerates freely while it is inside [Lo, Hi], and a spring brings it back to the edge it crossed or was already past.

constructors.name: NewGlide
constructors.signature: NewGlide(x0, v0, lo, hi float64, d Decay, s Spring) Glide
constructors.synopsis: NewGlide starts a glide at x0 with velocity v0, in units and units per second.

methods.name: At
methods.synopsis: At returns the position and velocity t after the release.

methods.name: Done
methods.synopsis: Done reports whether the glide has come to rest within eps.

methods.name: Rest
methods.synopsis: Rest is where the glide comes to rest.

Spring.synopsis: Spring is a damped spring in SwiftUI's parametrisation.

methods.name: At
methods.signature: At(t time.Duration, from, to, v0 float64) (x, v float64)
methods.synopsis: At returns the position and velocity t after the spring was let go at from with velocity v0, pulling towards to.

methods.name: Duration
methods.synopsis: Duration is how long the spring takes from a standing start to settle within eps of a target dist away: an upper bound for an animation window such as [gift.EventContext.Animate].

methods.name: Settled
methods.signature: Settled(t time.Duration, from, to, v0, eps float64) bool
methods.synopsis: Settled reports whether the spring is within eps of its target and slower than ten eps per second, the point at which a frame more or less is invisible.

funcs.name: Band
funcs.signature: Band(x, lo, hi, dim float64) float64
funcs.synopsis: Band maps a position to what is shown for it when the content may be dragged between lo and hi and rubber bands beyond: positions inside are unchanged, positions outside are pulled back towards the edge by Rubber in a viewport of dim.

funcs.name: Lerp
funcs.synopsis: Lerp interpolates from a to b by f.

funcs.name: Project
funcs.synopsis: Project returns how far a fling with velocity v, in units per second, travels before it comes to rest under the deceleration rate per millisecond: Apple's v/1000 · rate/(1 − rate).

funcs.name: Rubber
funcs.synopsis: Rubber returns the displacement shown for a pull of x past an edge, in a viewport of size dim along the same axis: UIKit's (1 − 1/(x·c/dim + 1))·dim with c = 0.55.

funcs.name: RubberInverse
funcs.synopsis: RubberInverse is the pull that Rubber shows as r: the finger travel that produced a displacement.
