constructors.synopsis: PrefetchPicture is RequestPicture at asset.Prefetch priority and without a layout when the answer arrives: for the neighbours of what is on screen, which should be ready when they are needed and must not delay what is needed now.

constructors.name: RequestPicture
constructors.signature: RequestPicture(ctx *gift.LayoutContext, src asset.Source, size int) Picture
constructors.synopsis: RequestPicture asks the shared image service for src at size pixels along its longest edge, and returns the handle.

methods.name: Dimensions
methods.synopsis: Dimensions are the oriented pixel dimensions the pipeline reported for the picture, or zero before it has.

methods.name: Draw
methods.signature: Draw(ctx *gift.PaintContext, dst geom.Rect, tint Color, radius float32) bool
methods.synopsis: Draw draws the whole picture stretched into dst, in the local space of the node being painted, with tint and with its corners rounded by radius.

methods.name: DrawCover
methods.signature: DrawCover(ctx *gift.PaintContext, dst geom.Rect, tint Color, radius float32) bool
methods.synopsis: DrawCover draws the picture into dst like FitCover: the centred part of it with the aspect ratio of dst.

methods.name: Err
methods.synopsis: Err is the permanent failure of the picture, or nil.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.synopsis: Prepare makes the picture resident without drawing it, and reports whether it is.

methods.name: Ready
methods.synopsis: Ready reports whether the pixels have arrived.

methods.name: Rung
methods.synopsis: Rung is the ladder rung the pixels were produced at, or zero before they have arrived.

PopoverEdge.synopsis: PopoverEdge says on which side of its anchor a popover appears.

PopoverView.synopsis: PopoverView shows content in a card next to an anchor, above everything else in the window.

constructors.name: Popover
constructors.synopsis: Popover returns anchor with a popover of content that is shown while PopoverView.Presented is true.

methods.name: Arrow
methods.synopsis: Arrow sets whether the card points at its anchor.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background sets the colour of the card.

methods.name: Edge
methods.synopsis: Edge sets the preferred side; see PopoverEdge.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex sets the flex factor of the anchor in a stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name of the popover.

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth caps the width of the card.

methods.name: OnDismiss
methods.synopsis: OnDismiss sets the function called on a press outside the popover and on escape.

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the space between the card and its content.

methods.name: Presented
methods.synopsis: Presented shows the popover while b is true.

ProgressBarView.synopsis: ProgressBarView shows how much of a task is done, or that one is running when there is no way to say how much.

constructors.name: ProgressBar
constructors.synopsis: ProgressBar returns a determinate progress bar at the given fraction.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the bar take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, which is the usual way to put one in a row.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes, which is how a bar is made thicker.

methods.name: Indeterminate
methods.synopsis: Indeterminate switches the bar to the mode that says "something is happening" without saying how much of it.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name of the bar: what is making progress.

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the bar; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the bar; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: Tint
methods.synopsis: Tint sets the colour of the filled part, replacing ColorAccent.

ProgressRingView.synopsis: ProgressRingView shows how far a task has come as a ring that fills clockwise, or that a task is under way as a spinner.

constructors.name: ProgressRing
constructors.synopsis: ProgressRing returns a ring that is fraction full, clockwise from twelve o'clock, over a faint track: the circular counterpart of ProgressBar, as iOS draws an activity ring.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex sets the flex factor in a stack.

methods.name: Indeterminate
methods.synopsis: Indeterminate shows the turning spinner of iOS instead of a ring, for a task whose end nobody knows.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name.

methods.name: LineWidth
methods.synopsis: LineWidth sets the width of the ring; the default is a seventh of the size.

methods.name: Size
methods.synopsis: Size sets the diameter; the default is 28.

methods.name: Tint
methods.synopsis: Tint sets the colour of the ring, ColorAccent by default, or of the spinner, ColorSecondaryLabel by default.

RowView.synopsis: RowView is the standard row of a ListView: a leading icon, a title over an optional subtitle, and a trailing accessory.

constructors.name: Row
constructors.synopsis: Row returns a row with the given title.

methods.name: Accessory
methods.synopsis: Accessory sets the trailing view: a ToggleView, a BadgeView, anything.

methods.name: Chevron
methods.synopsis: Chevron sets the trailing symbol that says "this row leads somewhere", drawn faintly at the very end of the row:

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the row out of input and draws its title and leading icon in ColorSecondaryLabel and its subtitle fainter still; see RowView.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the row take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Icon
methods.synopsis: Icon sets the leading symbol, drawn in ColorAccent.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name of the row's command, replacing the title.

methods.name: OnTap
methods.synopsis: OnTap makes the whole row a control that runs fn when it is activated.

methods.name: Subtitle
methods.synopsis: Subtitle sets a second, quieter line under the title.

methods.name: Value
methods.synopsis: Value sets a trailing label, for the current setting of whatever the row names: "kiosk-net", "60 %", "Off".

ScreenSpec.synopsis: ScreenSpec is one screen of a NavigationStackView.

constructors.name: Screen
constructors.synopsis: Screen describes one screen of a navigation stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation identity of this screen, replacing the default of the title; see Screen.

ScrollBar.synopsis: ScrollBar is the look and the timing of the scroll indicator of a viewport.
ScrollBar.decl:
type ScrollBar struct {
	Hidden   bool
	Width    float32
	MinThumb float32
	Margin   float32
	Track    Color
	Thumb    Color
	Hold     time.Duration
	Fade     time.Duration
}

ScrollView.synopsis: ScrollView is a viewport that clips its children and lets the user move them along one axis.

constructors.name: HScroll
constructors.synopsis: HScroll arranges its children from leading to trailing and scrolls horizontally.

constructors.name: VScroll
constructors.synopsis: VScroll arranges its children from top to bottom and scrolls vertically.

methods.name: Align
methods.synopsis: Align sets the cross axis alignment of the children, exactly as Stack.Align.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the viewport behind the content.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the viewport bounds after the content was drawn, so the content scrolls underneath it.

methods.name: Bounce
methods.synopsis: Bounce turns the rubber band off with false: the content then stops dead at its ends instead of being pulled past them and springing back.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip is accepted only as Clip(true), which is already what a scroll view does; Clip(false) panics.

methods.name: Config
methods.synopsis: Config replaces the whole gesture configuration in one call.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius rounds the background and the border.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the viewport take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, proportional to v.

methods.name: FlingVelocity
methods.synopsis: FlingVelocity sets the release speed, in logical pixels per second, below which a drag ends in a stop rather than a fling.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: Friction
methods.synopsis: Friction sets the exponential decay rate of a fling in reciprocal seconds, replacing gift.DefaultScrollFriction for this container.

methods.name: Gap
methods.synopsis: Gap sets the space inserted between two adjacent children, exactly as Stack.Gap.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: MaxHeight
methods.synopsis: MaxHeight lowers the maximum height of the viewport, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the viewport, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinHeight
methods.synopsis: MinHeight raises the minimum height of the viewport, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the viewport, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the same padding on all four edges, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the padding per edge, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: Refreshable
methods.synopsis: Refreshable adds the pull-to-refresh of iOS to a vertical scroll view: content pulled down past its top far enough calls onRefresh, once per pull, and while refreshing is true the content rests a little below its top with a spinner turning in the room above it.

methods.name: ScrollBar
methods.synopsis: ScrollBar sets the look and the timing of the scroll indicator.

methods.name: Shadow
methods.synopsis: Shadow draws a blurred copy of the viewport's box behind it.

methods.name: WheelStep
methods.synopsis: WheelStep sets how far one unit of wheel delta scrolls, in logical pixels, replacing gift.DefaultScrollWheelStep.

SearchFieldView.synopsis: SearchFieldView is a field for a search term.

constructors.name: SearchField
constructors.synopsis: SearchField returns the search field of iOS: a TextField in a rounded box with a magnifying glass in front and, while it holds text, a button behind that clears it.

methods.name: Bind
methods.synopsis: Bind reads the text from b and writes every edit back.

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the field out of input.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex sets the flex factor in a stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name; the placeholder is used without one.

methods.name: OnChange
methods.synopsis: OnChange sets the function called with the text after every edit, clearing included.

methods.name: OnSubmit
methods.synopsis: OnSubmit sets the function called with the text when enter is pressed.

methods.name: Placeholder
methods.synopsis: Placeholder sets the text shown while the field is empty.

SectionHeaderView.synopsis: SectionHeaderView is the caption above a group of rows in a ListView.

constructors.name: Section
constructors.synopsis: Section returns a section header for use inside a List.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the header take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

SegmentedControlView.synopsis: SegmentedControlView is a row of mutually exclusive choices with a sliding indicator over the chosen one.

constructors.name: SegmentedControl
constructors.signature: SegmentedControl(selected int, labels []string, onChange func(int)) SegmentedControlView
constructors.synopsis: SegmentedControl returns a segmented control showing labels with segment selected marked, and calling onChange with the index the user asked for.

methods.name: Capsule
methods.synopsis: Capsule rounds the tray and the indicator fully and lifts the indicator with a soft shadow, the segmented control of iOS 26.

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the control out of input.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the control take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Font
methods.synopsis: Font sets the typeface of every label, replacing the default font.

methods.name: FontSize
methods.synopsis: FontSize sets the em size of every label in pixels, as TextView.FontSize does.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name of the control as a whole — what the choice is about, as opposed to the choices, which are the segments' own labels.

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the control; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the control; see [frameSpec].

Shadow.synopsis: Shadow is a blurred copy of the shape of a view, drawn behind it.

SheetView.synopsis: SheetView presents one view in a panel that slides up from the bottom edge over another view, and takes the input of everything underneath.

constructors.name: Sheet
constructors.synopsis: Sheet returns content with sheet presented over it from the bottom edge.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the sheet host take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Height
methods.synopsis: Height sets the height of the panel as a fraction of the height it is presented in, in (0, 1].

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth sets the widest the panel gets.

methods.name: OnDismiss
methods.synopsis: OnDismiss makes a tap on the scrim and the escape key call fn.

methods.name: Presented
methods.synopsis: Presented says whether the sheet is on the screen right now; see ModalView.Presented.

methods.name: Scrim
methods.synopsis: Scrim sets the wash drawn over the content while the sheet is up; see ModalView.Scrim.

SliderView.synopsis: SliderView is a continuous control for a value in a range.

constructors.name: Slider
constructors.synopsis: Slider returns a slider showing value and calling onChange with the value the user asked for.

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the slider out of input.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the slider take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, which is the usual way to put one in a row.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name of the slider: what a person would call the quantity.

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the slider; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the slider; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: Range
methods.synopsis: Range sets the ends of the value range, replacing the default of 0 to 1.

methods.name: Step
methods.synopsis: Step quantises the value to multiples of v counted from the minimum, for the pointer and for the keyboard alike.

methods.name: Tint
methods.synopsis: Tint sets the colour of the filled part of the track, replacing ColorAccent.

SpacerView.synopsis: SpacerView is a flexible, invisible gap.

constructors.name: Spacer
constructors.synopsis: Spacer returns a flexible gap with a flex of one and no minimum length.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex sets the share of the remaining main axis space this spacer takes.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: MinLength
methods.synopsis: MinLength sets the smallest main axis extent of the spacer.

Stack.synopsis: Stack is a vertical or horizontal stack of children.

constructors.name: HStack
constructors.synopsis: HStack arranges its children from leading to trailing.

constructors.name: VStack
constructors.synopsis: VStack arranges its children from top to bottom.

methods.name: Align
methods.synopsis: Align sets the cross axis alignment of the children.

methods.name: AlignBaseline
methods.synopsis: AlignBaseline lines the children up on their first text baseline instead of on an edge or the centre.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the bounds behind the children.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border strokes the inside of the bounds after the children were drawn.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip confines the children to the full bounds, not to the padded bounds; see gift.Element.Clip.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius rounds the background and the border.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the stack take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack, proportional to v.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes both axes.

methods.name: Gap
methods.synopsis: Gap sets the space inserted between two adjacent children.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

methods.name: MaxHeight
methods.synopsis: MaxHeight lowers the maximum height of the node, and the minimum with it if that is higher; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth lowers the maximum width of the node, and the minimum with it if that is higher.

methods.name: MinHeight
methods.synopsis: MinHeight raises the minimum height of the node, and the maximum with it if that is lower; see [frameSpec].

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth raises the minimum width of the node.

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the same padding on all four edges, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the padding per edge, replacing any previous padding.

methods.name: Shadow
methods.synopsis: Shadow draws a blurred copy of the view's shape — its bounds, rounded by the corner radius — behind the view.

StepperView.synopsis: StepperView changes a number by a step at a time.

constructors.name: Stepper
constructors.synopsis: Stepper returns a minus and a plus button side by side, the counterpart of UIStepper and of the control of SwiftUI's Stepper.

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the stepper out of input.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex sets the flex factor in a stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name.

methods.name: Range
methods.synopsis: Range sets the smallest and the largest value.

methods.name: Step
methods.synopsis: Step sets how much one step changes the value; it must be greater than zero.

methods.name: Wraps
methods.synopsis: Wraps makes a step past one end go to the other, as UIStepper's wraps does.

SwipeActionView.synopsis: SwipeActionView is one action behind a Swipe row.

constructors.name: SwipeAction
constructors.synopsis: SwipeAction returns an action with a title that runs action when it is tapped or, as the first of its edge, swiped through.

methods.name: Destructive
methods.synopsis: Destructive marks the action as one that deletes, in ColorDanger.

methods.name: Icon
methods.synopsis: Icon puts a symbol above the title.

methods.name: Tint
methods.synopsis: Tint sets the colour of the action.

SwipeView.synopsis: SwipeView is a row with actions behind it.

constructors.name: Swipe
constructors.synopsis: Swipe returns content as a row that a finger or a mouse drags sideways to uncover actions behind it, the swipe actions of UITableView and of SwiftUI's swipeActions.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background sets the colour behind the content, which covers the actions.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex sets the flex factor in a stack.

methods.name: FullSwipe
methods.synopsis: FullSwipe with false stops a drag far through from running the first action; the row then only opens.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key.

methods.name: Leading
methods.synopsis: Leading sets the actions a drag to the right uncovers, the first at the left edge.

methods.name: Trailing
methods.synopsis: Trailing sets the actions a drag to the left uncovers, the first at the right edge.

Symbol.synopsis: Symbol is one icon's geometry: pre-parsed outlines, ready to be rasterised at whatever size and density they are drawn at.

constructors.name: NewSymbol
constructors.synopsis: NewSymbol wraps encoded icon geometry produced by cmd/gift-icongen.

methods.name: Draw
methods.signature: Draw(ctx *gift.PaintContext, dst geom.Rect, c Color, px int) bool
methods.synopsis: Draw draws the symbol into dst, in the local space of the node being painted, tinted with c: the mask of an Icon without the view, for a painter that composes symbols with its own drawing — a control that fades in and out, say, which a view of its own cannot do because nothing in gift fades a subtree.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.synopsis: IsZero reports whether s carries no geometry.

TabBarView.synopsis: TabBarView is the primary navigation of a kiosk: a row of icon-and-caption items along the bottom of the window, one screen above them.

constructors.name: TabBar
constructors.signature: TabBar(selected int, onSelect func(int), tabs ...TabSpec) TabBarView
constructors.synopsis: TabBar returns a tab bar showing the content of tabs[selected] and calling onSelect with the index of the tab the user asked for.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex makes the tab bar take a share of the remaining main axis space of its parent stack.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key of this view among its siblings.

TabSpec.synopsis: TabSpec is one tab: what the bar shows for it and what it contains.

constructors.name: Tab
constructors.signature: Tab(title string, sym Symbol, content gift.View) TabSpec
constructors.synopsis: Tab describes one tab of a TabBarView.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation identity of this tab, replacing the default of the title; see Tab.

methods.name: SelectedIcon
methods.synopsis: SelectedIcon sets the symbol drawn while this tab is the selected one.

TextAlign.synopsis: TextAlign is the horizontal alignment of the lines of a TextView inside its own width.

TextAreaView.synopsis: TextAreaView edits text of several lines.

constructors.name: TextArea
constructors.synopsis: TextArea returns an area editing ed, three lines tall at least and growing without limit; see TextAreaView.Lines.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background sets the face.

methods.name: Bind
methods.synopsis: Bind reads the text from b and writes every edit back; see TextFieldView.Bind.

methods.name: Border
methods.synopsis: Border sets the outline.

methods.name: CaretColor
methods.synopsis: CaretColor sets the colour of the caret.

methods.name: Clip
methods.synopsis: Clip panics for false, as TextFieldView.Clip does: the lines scroll inside the area.

methods.name: CornerRadius
methods.synopsis: CornerRadius sets the radius of the corners.

methods.name: Disabled
methods.synopsis: Disabled takes the area out of input.

methods.name: Flex
methods.synopsis: Flex sets the flex factor in a stack.

methods.name: FocusRing
methods.synopsis: FocusRing sets the ring drawn while the area holds a visible focus.

methods.name: Font
methods.synopsis: Font sets the font of the text.

methods.name: FontSize
methods.synopsis: FontSize sets the size of the text, which is also what a line is measured in.

methods.name: Foreground
methods.synopsis: Foreground sets the colour of the text.

methods.name: Frame
methods.synopsis: Frame fixes the size; see BoxView.Frame.

methods.name: Key
methods.synopsis: Key sets the reconciliation key.

methods.name: Label
methods.synopsis: Label sets the accessible name; see TextFieldView.Label.

methods.name: Lines
methods.synopsis: Lines sets the height of the area in lines of its font: at least min, and growing with the text up to max, past which the lines scroll.

methods.name: MaxHeight
methods.synopsis: MaxHeight sets the largest height, past which the lines scroll.

methods.name: MaxWidth
methods.synopsis: MaxWidth sets the largest width.

methods.name: MinHeight
methods.synopsis: MinHeight sets the smallest height.

methods.name: MinWidth
methods.synopsis: MinWidth sets the smallest width.

methods.name: OnChange
methods.synopsis: OnChange sets the function called with the text after every edit.

methods.name: OnSubmit
methods.synopsis: OnSubmit sets the function called with the text when the user presses enter with gift.ShortcutModifier, because enter alone starts a new line here.

methods.name: Padding
methods.synopsis: Padding sets the room between the edge and the text on every side.

methods.name: PaddingInsets
methods.synopsis: PaddingInsets sets the room between the edge and the text per side.

methods.name: Placeholder
methods.synopsis: Placeholder sets the text shown while the area is empty; see TextFieldView.Placeholder.

methods.name: PlaceholderColor
methods.synopsis: PlaceholderColor sets the colour of the placeholder.

methods.name: SelectionColor
methods.synopsis: SelectionColor sets the colour behind selected text.

methods.name: Shadow
methods.synopsis: Shadow sets the shadow.

TextEditor.synopsis: TextEditor is the document a TextFieldView edits, together with the state of editing it: the caret, the selection anchor, the horizontal scroll of the field and the phase of the blink.

constructors.name: Editor
constructors.synopsis: Editor returns the editor named name inside the component instance ctx belongs to, creating it with initial on first use.

constructors.name: NewTextEditor
constructors.synopsis: NewTextEditor returns an editor holding s, with the caret after the last character and nothing selected.

methods.name: Caret
methods.synopsis: Caret returns the byte offset the next character would be inserted at.

methods.name: DeleteBackward
methods.synopsis: DeleteBackward removes the selection if there is one, and otherwise the rune before the caret.

methods.name: DeleteForward
methods.synopsis: DeleteForward removes the selection if there is one, and otherwise the rune after the caret.

methods.name: DeleteSelection
methods.synopsis: DeleteSelection removes the selected text and reports whether there was any.

methods.name: HasSelection
methods.synopsis: HasSelection reports whether any text is selected.

methods.name: Insert
methods.synopsis: Insert replaces the selection with s and leaves the caret after it.

methods.name: InsertRune
methods.synopsis: InsertRune is TextEditor.Insert for one character, without building a string for it.

methods.name: Len
methods.synopsis: Len returns the length of the text in bytes.

methods.name: MoveCaret
methods.synopsis: MoveCaret puts the caret at off.

methods.name: MoveEnd
methods.synopsis: MoveEnd is TextEditor.MoveHome at the other end.

methods.name: MoveHome
methods.synopsis: MoveHome and MoveEnd move the caret to the ends of the document.

methods.name: MoveLeft
methods.synopsis: MoveLeft and MoveRight move the caret by one rune.

methods.name: MoveRight
methods.synopsis: MoveRight is TextEditor.MoveLeft in the other direction.

methods.name: MoveWordLeft
methods.synopsis: MoveWordLeft and MoveWordRight move the caret to the near edge of the adjacent word; see [runeClass] for what a word is here.

methods.name: MoveWordRight
methods.synopsis: MoveWordRight is TextEditor.MoveWordLeft in the other direction.

methods.name: SelectAll
methods.synopsis: SelectAll selects the whole document and leaves the caret at the end.

methods.name: SelectWordAt
methods.synopsis: SelectWordAt selects the run of text around off, where a run is what [runeClass] says it is: a word, a stretch of whitespace, or a stretch of punctuation.

methods.name: SelectedText
methods.synopsis: SelectedText returns the selected text, which is "" when nothing is selected.

methods.name: Selection
methods.synopsis: Selection returns the selected byte range as the ordered pair start, end.

methods.name: SetCaret
methods.synopsis: SetCaret moves the caret to off and clears the selection.

methods.name: SetSelection
methods.synopsis: SetSelection selects the byte range from a to b and puts the caret at b, so that a following shifted arrow extends from the end the caller named last.

methods.name: SetText
methods.synopsis: SetText replaces the whole document, puts the caret at the end and clears the selection.

methods.name: Text
methods.synopsis: Text returns the current contents.

TextFieldView.synopsis: TextFieldView is a single line text field.

constructors.name: SecureField
constructors.synopsis: SecureField returns a field for a password or a PIN, the counterpart of SwiftUI's SecureField: a TextField that shows a dot for every character.

constructors.name: TextField
constructors.synopsis: TextField returns a field editing ed.

methods.name: Background
methods.synopsis: Background fills the bounds behind the text, replacing the themed ColorControl.

methods.name: Bind
methods.synopsis: Bind connects the field to a gift.State holding the text, in both directions: every edit writes the state, and a value written to the state from anywhere else replaces the document.

methods.name: Border
